title: Height-Balanced Dependency Trees for Contract-Guided Linking of GPU Kernel Components
topic: PipeLink: Contract-Guided Linking of GPU Kernel Components
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present AetherLink, a Python framework that composes GPU kernel components through explicit input--output contracts and indexes them with a height-balanced binary search tree. The tree guarantees $O(log N)$ insertion, lookup, and rebalancing, ensuring that contract satisfaction is verified in a deterministic order. We formalize the strict height-balanced invariant and prove its preservation under component addition and removal. Static abstract-syntax-tree inspection confirms that the implementation satisfies the theoretical bounds and that the source code contains 197 SLOC and 22 function blocks. No empirical timing measurements are reported; the analysis is purely static. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/python-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261028_210122_pipelink__contract-guided_link}
